# Requirements Document: Creating an order from an offer

## Introduction

The ONE Order way: each offer item becomes one order item, and each order item
gets one service per passenger and flight segment, since an ordered service is
for one passenger on one segment.

These requirements are generated from the Lean model in [`Rules/OneOrder/Accept.lean`](https://github.com/samdengler/verified-air/blob/main/Rules/OneOrder/Accept.lean). Each acceptance criterion carries the status the build computed for it: *proven* means a theorem the build checked, *example only* means a computed example, *open* means a theorem the build could not prove, and *not checked* means no theorem or example covers it yet.

## Requirements

### Requirement ONE-001

**User Story:** As an airline, I want each accepted offer item to become one order item with a service for every passenger and segment, so that each service can be delivered and accounted for on its own.

**Rule:** WHEN a customer accepts an offer THE SYSTEM SHALL create an order with one order item for each offer item and one service for each passenger and flight segment of that item. (Lean: `accept`)

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN an offer is accepted THE SYSTEM SHALL create exactly one order item for each offer item.
   - ONE-001.1, proven: proven theorem `accept_item_per_offer_item`; example `acceptFamilyOffer`
2. WHEN an order item is created THE SYSTEM SHALL give it one service for each passenger and flight segment of its offer item.
   - ONE-001.2, proven: proven theorem `accept_services_per_passenger_segment`; example `acceptFamilyOffer`
3. WHEN an order is created THE SYSTEM SHALL give its order items distinct references.
   - ONE-001.3, proven: proven theorem `accept_item_ids_unique`; example `acceptFamilyOffer`
4. WHEN an order is created THE SYSTEM SHALL mark it opened.
   - ONE-001.4, proven: proven theorem `accept_order_opened`; example `acceptFamilyOffer`
5. IF a customer accepts an offer at or after its expiry instant THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it as expired.
   - ONE-001.5, proven: proven theorem `accept_rejects_expired`; example `acceptFamilyAtExpiry`
